leads.title: Rat-Infested Gaza Camps and Non-Healing Wounds at Nasser Hospital
leads.thesis: A BBC report from Nasser Hospital documents rat-infested displacement camps in the Gaza Strip where injured children, including a 6-year-old girl, suffer non-healing wounds amid dire sanitation.

leads.title: Tennessee Execution Fails Despite Two Lethal Injections
leads.thesis: Tennessee halted executions after officials failed to execute Christa Gail Pike — the state's death-row woman since 1996 — despite two doses of lethal drugs, prompting a Supreme Court intervention and a governor-ordered pause.

leads.title: White House Blocks CNN From Press Pool Despite Court Order
leads.thesis: The White House blocked CNN from pool duty covering President Trump despite a judge having lifted a prior ban, escalating a press-access fight.

leads.title: Mersin Mayor Detained in Widening Turkey Municipal Corruption Probe
leads.thesis: Mersin Metropolitan Mayor Vahap Seçer was detained in a corruption investigation targeting multiple municipalities, marking the latest opposition-led city hall swept into Turkey's crackdown.

leads.title: France Unveils €54 Billion Savings Budget Before 2027 Election
leads.thesis: Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu presented a budget aiming for €54 billion in savings, framing austerity as the path to fiscal credibility ahead of France's 2027 presidential election.

leads.title: Australia Launches Nation-First Inquiry Into AI 'Genie'
leads.thesis: Australia opened its first major national inquiry into the impacts of AI, warning of severe consequences if the 'genie' is left unchecked while also seeking benefits.

leads.title: Indian Pilot Hailed as Hero After FlyDubai Mid-Air Attack and Diversion
leads.thesis: Captain Smit Machchhar, an Indian pilot, was praised by India's Jaishankar and Israel's Netanyahu for saving 174 lives after an altercation forced a FlyDubai flight to make an emergency landing, prompting a suspension of FlyDubai Israel flights.

leads.title: US Troops Complete 23-Year Withdrawal From Iraq
leads.thesis: American forces completed their withdrawal from Iraq, ending a 23-year military presence that began in 2003, with Reuters noting risks of emboldened Iranian proxies and Islamic State remnants.

leads.title: Hundreds Arrested as French Student Protests Escalate
leads.thesis: French authorities arrested hundreds as student-led protests escalated, overlapping with budget austerity announcements and broader social unrest.

leads.title: UK Wind and Solar Saved £5.9 Billion in Gas Imports During Hormuz Crisis
leads.thesis: Carbon Brief analysis found UK wind and solar avoided £5.9 billion in gas imports while the Strait of Hormuz was disrupted, quantifying renewables' security value.

leads.title: US States' Climate Superfund Laws Face Court Test Against Big Oil
leads.thesis: Courts are weighing state climate superfund laws that would make major oil companies pay for climate harms, a novel liability push now under judicial review.

leads.title: Indonesia Haze Chokes Neighbors With Little Legal Recourse
leads.thesis: Transboundary haze from Indonesia is again choking neighboring countries, but affected populations have little legal recourse under current frameworks.

leads.title: Dutch Test Rice to Save Sinking Peatlands
leads.thesis: Researchers in the Netherlands are trialing rice as a new crop to keep peatlands wet and halt sinking, subsidence and carbon release.

leads.title: New Map Ranks US Rivers Most Worth Protecting
leads.thesis: Scientists released a new map pinpointing US rivers most worth protecting for biodiversity and conservation value.

leads.title: CHIME Telescope Unlocks New Way to Study Universe's Expansion
leads.thesis: Canada's CHIME telescope used ancient hydrogen signals to open a new method for measuring the universe's baffling expansion rate.

leads.title: Surprisingly Complex Brain Waves Reveal Inner Workings
leads.thesis: Quanta reports that surprisingly complex traveling waves in the brain are revealing how neural circuits coordinate thought and perception.

leads.title: Mathematicians Use Randomness to Crack 55-Year-Old Conjecture
leads.thesis: Mathematicians harnessed randomness to resolve a 55-year-old conjecture, Quanta reports, marking a breakthrough in combinatorics/probability.

leads.title: Dinosaur-Killing Crater May Have Teemed With Life Soon After Impact
leads.thesis: Research on the Chicxulub impact crater suggests it was teeming with life relatively soon after the dinosaur-killing asteroid strike.

leads.title: Stratolaunch Boeing 777 Boosts US Hypersonic Testing by 35%
leads.thesis: Stratolaunch's modified Boeing 777 increased US hypersonic testing capacity by 35%, expanding defense programs' flight-test throughput.

leads.title: Galileo Space Building Satellites That Process Signals in Orbit
leads.thesis: Startup Galileo Space is building satellites that turn raw signals into answers in orbit, processing data onboard rather than downlinking everything.

leads.title: NASA Crew-13 Aims for Fastest US Trip to the ISS
leads.thesis: NASA's Crew-13 mission could make the fastest US crewed trip to the International Space Station, testing a rapid rendezvous profile.

leads.title: Google Unveils Gemini 4 Argon as Most Powerful Model Yet
leads.thesis: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Argon, calling it its most powerful model yet and its next era of frontier intelligence, with restricted access to trusted testers.

leads.title: OpenAI Says It Disrupted Coordinated Model-Distillation Campaign
leads.thesis: OpenAI disclosed disrupting a coordinated campaign to distill its models, alleging systematic extraction attempts by external actors.

leads.title: Cloudflare to Issue Quantum-Safe TLS Certificates
leads.thesis: Cloudflare plans to issue quantum-safe TLS certificates, preparing the web for post-quantum cryptography before quantum computers break current encryption.

leads.title: Critical Zimbra Flaw Actively Exploited to Steal Emails
leads.thesis: Attackers have been actively exploiting a critical Zimbra flaw to steal emails, Ars Technica reports, putting enterprise mail servers at risk.

leads.title: Trump's AI Safety Accord Dismissed as 'Fancy Pinky-Swear'
leads.thesis: Wired analysis calls President Trump's AI Safety Accord a non-binding 'fancy pinky-swear' lacking enforcement mechanisms.

leads.title: DeepMind Launches SynthID Bio Watermarking
leads.thesis: DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio, extending its watermarking toolkit to biological sequences and AI-generated bio data.

leads.title: Australia's Lynas Eyes Brazil Rare Earths via Meteoric Takeover
leads.thesis: Australia's Lynas Rare Earths is pursuing a takeover bid for Brazil's Meteoric Resources to diversify supply beyond China.

leads.title: China's Carmakers Target Record 12 Million Overseas Sales in 2026
leads.thesis: China's automakers eye a record 12 million overseas vehicle sales in 2026 as their go-global strategy pays off, SCMP reports.

leads.title: Pandora Opens $150 Million Vietnam Plant to Diversify Beyond Thailand
leads.thesis: Jeweler Pandora opened a $150 million plant in Vietnam to diversify its manufacturing footprint beyond Thailand.

leads.title: Trump Unveils $200 Billion in South Korean Energy Investments in US
leads.thesis: President Trump unveiled $200 billion in US energy investments pledged by South Korea, framing it as a win for American energy security.

leads.title: India and US Report Productive Talks on Early Trade Deal
leads.thesis: India's Commerce Minister Goyal reported productive discussions with USTR Greer on early conclusion of a bilateral trade deal, amid tariff tensions.

leads.title: Kobe Shootings Leave One Dead and One Injured
leads.thesis: Shootings in Kobe, Japan left one dead and one injured, a rare gun violence incident in a country with strict firearm controls.

leads.title: DR Congo Official Killed Defending Ebola Response Is Buried
leads.thesis: Mourners buried a DR Congo official killed after defending the Ebola response, highlighting violence against health workers.

leads.title: South African Anti-Migrant Protesters Vow to Keep Marching
leads.thesis: Anti-migrant protesters in South Africa vowed to keep marching, saying there is 'no backing down' amid rising xenophobic mobilization.

leads.title: Sanofi and Regeneron Expand Partnership After Dupixent Success
leads.thesis: Sanofi and Regeneron expanded their partnership following Dupixent's success, extending collaboration on immunology antibodies.

leads.title: Intravenous Oncolytic Adenovirus With Chemotherapy Shows Promise for Metastatic Disease
leads.thesis: A Nature Medicine study reports an intravenous hyaluronidase-expressing oncolytic adenovirus combined with chemotherapy for metastatic disease.

leads.title: Review Links Cannabis Use to Twice the Risk of Violence
leads.thesis: A review found cannabis users were twice as likely to commit violence, reigniting debate over causation versus correlation in drug policy.

leads.title: Exhaling May Speed Up Reaction Times
leads.thesis: New research finds exhaling may speed up reaction times, with breathing rhythms synced to brain activity.

leads.title: Anglo-Saxons Got Special Treatment in Medieval Rome
leads.thesis: New research finds Anglo-Saxons received special treatment in medieval Rome, suggesting privileged status for English pilgrims and clergy.

leads.title: Paper Claims All Unitaries Have Constant-Depth Quantum Circuits
leads.thesis: An arXiv paper claims all unitaries have constant-depth quantum circuits, a striking theoretical result with implications for quantum complexity.

leads.title: JWST Probes Reionization History and Bubble Sizes With Lyman-Alpha
leads.thesis: A JWST Lyman-alpha study probes the history of cosmic reionization and the sizes of ionized bubbles in the early universe.
